opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied, for the reason that application therefor was not made within the time provided by law. Act of February 13, 1925, § 8 (a), (43 Stat. 936, 940; U. S. Code, Title 28, § 350).
